scheme_name: Entrepreneurship Development by SC & ST Women in Science Technology Engineering Mathematics
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must be a woman belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST)
Applicant must be working in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) areas in Kerala
Applicant must hold a Ph.D. in Science/Technology/Engineering or an M.Sc. in Basic/Natural Science or an M.Tech in Science/Technology/Engineering
Applicant must initially identify a host institution and a mentor (regular faculty of the host institute)
Application can also be submitted by nomination from the Head of S&T Institutions across Kerala
Applicant must join the host institute within 15 days of receiving the initial grant
Co‑mentorship is encouraged and the co‑mentor must have experience in enterprise creation
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20 lakh per grant, covering a monthly fellowship (₹35‑₹45 k) and project costs (capital, operational and overhead) for one year.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from Head of Institution (if nominated)
Technical documents as specified in the call
